about_the_game:
Survive in a world of chaos alongside Hjorti — a living heart trapped in a crazy game simulation! Battles are endless, enemies are merciless, and your heart must come up with its own strategies to survive and complete the levels.

What makes the game unique:

Modular combat system: collect turrets, shields, attacks, and other modules like puzzle pieces to create your own deadly combinations. Experiment, mix, and conquer levels on your own terms!

Survival mode: endless waves of enemies, increasingly difficult challenges, and insane attack combos — only the most creative will survive.

Bosses with personality: each boss has unique abilities and behaviors that put your strategy to the test.

Dark humor and sarcasm: Hjorti swears, jokes, and laughs at everything — if you enjoy sharp humor and a wild atmosphere, this game is for you.

Get ready for chaos, creativity, and dark humor! Craft your strategy and survive the waves of enemies!

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains strong profanity and adult humor, including jokes with sexual undertones. The game contains violence: enemies are killed with red blood splatters and particles. There may also be themes of alcohol and drug abuse.

The game does not contain realistic sexual scenes or sexual violence, but there is dark humor and elements of violence in a fantasy context.
